Real Bot is Real's sports assistant. Ask a question in plain English and it looks up the answer in Real's stats, games, plays, cards, polls and predictions data. It answers with numbers, tables, and things you can tap.

Real Bot opens from the search bar. Ask follow-ups in the same conversation ("what about on the road?") and it remembers what you were talking about.

**On this page**

* What you can ask: stats, leaderboards, games, cards and your activity
* Things you can do from an answer: predictions, polls, lineups, links
* Game situations: baseball, football and basketball splits
* Tips for better answers
* What Real Bot can't do (yet)

Real Bot can set up an action for you, but you always tap to confirm it. It never makes a prediction, answers a poll or submits a lineup for you.

| Action                                                                   | Try                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Make a prediction**: open markets show up so you can tap an outcome    | "What can I predict in the NBA tonight?" · "Who's favored in the Lakers game?"                                                     |
| **Answer polls**: open polls you haven't answered yet                    | "Show me NHL polls I can fill out today" · "Any over/under polls tonight?" · "Polls for the Rangers game"                          |
| **Build a daily draft lineup**: a filled-in lineup you review and submit | "Build me an NBA lineup with Luka and LeBron" · "MLB lineup with Dodgers and Yankees players"                                      |

| **Jump to a screen**: a link straight to the page                        | "Take me to LeBron's page" · "LeBron 2005" · "Go to tonight's Lakers game" · "Open @username's profile" · "Open today's NBA draft" |
| **Open a specific moment**                                               | "Aaron Judge's best game this season" · "Kyrie Irving's best playoff play"                                                         |
| **Share an answer**                                                      | Tap share on any answer (answers about your own account stay private)                                                              |

***

* **Name the season** if you don't mean this one: "in 2024", "since 2023", "in June 2025". With no season named, career questions use all-time stats.
* **Say "playoffs"** for postseason only, or "including playoffs" to combine regular season and playoffs. Otherwise answers use the regular season.
* **Stack filters**: "Warriors road wins by 10+ against Western Conference teams"
* **Set a minimum**: "min 20 games", "at least 400 plate appearances"
* **Ask a follow-up**: "what about last season?", "now just home games"

***

* Lineup on/off data, like plus-minus with a specific teammate on the floor. It can tell you how a team did in games a player played or missed.
* Batter vs pitcher matchups, pitcher splits vs lefties/righties, and starter vs reliever splits
* Player-level football situations (only team situations are available)
* Pitch-level data (velocity, pitch type, exit velocity)
* Advanced tracking such as pace, usage, Corsi, possession or route data
* Projections or picks for future games
* Non-sports questions

When something isn't in Real's data, Real Bot tells you so instead of guessing.
